description: Figure 1 is a horizontal bar chart titled “Number of tasks by language family,” illustrating the count of tasks assigned to each of ten distinct language families. The horizontal axis, labeled “# tasks,” represents the quantity of tasks and is scaled linearly from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The vertical axis lists the language families in descending order of task count, from top to bottom: IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. Each language family is represented by a colored horizontal bar whose length corresponds to the number of tasks: IE-Slavic has 78 tasks (the longest bar, light blue), IE-Romance has 48 tasks (dark blue), IE-Germanic has 44 tasks (light green), Uralic has 21 tasks (green), IE-Baltic has 18 tasks (light pink), IE-other has 15 tasks (red), IE-Indic has 10 tasks (light orange), Semitic has 9 tasks (orange), Turkic has 5 tasks (light purple), and Basque has 2 tasks (dark purple). The bars are arranged with the highest value at the top and are not sorted alphabetically; no bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color coding.
